discord.title: 📊 Daily research summary · 2026-11-26
discord.text:
**5-min experiment (v18+):** 100 rounds observed, 10 alerts, 3 simulated trades. Won 1 of 3 (33%) vs 45% needed to break even; -$16.25 after fees. Progress 3/300, so too early to say anything.
**Data quality:** only 95/288 5-min rounds logged in the last 24h, 64/470 checks had no market quote, and a quote was there at the simulated tap in just 3/10 alerts at 30s (size unverified).
**15-min '12-minute rule' (historical, exploratory):** 2,022 trades over 6,454 past Kalshi rounds. Won 78.1% but needed 80.9%; -$632.13 at $10/trade (z -3.85). It loses even with zero fees. Kalshi and Polymarket US settled identically in 696/696 rounds.
**Safety:** no real orders, no keys, model still frozen. 2 of 63 workflow runs failed.
discord.discussed: ChatGPT reviewed the 8:06 PM scoreboard (#2: inconclusive, calibration was counting correlated checks), the Reddit 'halfway leader' idea (#5), and the team setup: Discord channel routing (#6), Obsidian vault (#7), Polybot Brain (#8). Claude posted the 15-min backtest results on #1.
discord.agreed: 15-min rules were frozen before the run and not changed after. #5 stays at L0 (source unreadable); if ever tested, the leader is set by the Up midpoint and labelled a different hypothesis. Scoreboard now uses 1 pre-set check per round and shows rounds vs checks separately (done). 5-min experiment stays frozen. AI reviews are opinions, not votes.
discord.disagreed: none. ChatGPT hasn't reviewed the 15-min results yet.
discord.next: ChatGPT reviews the Phase 1 report on #1. Claude finishes reviewing #6 (channel cleanup), #7 and #8. The 5-min test keeps collecting toward 300 trades.
discord.decision_needed: After ChatGPT's review: mark the 12-minute rule (#1) as refuted and skip the forward test? Claude recommends yes.
